quests.title: A Very Fishy Encounter

dialogue.t: Perfect, it looks like I'm all set...
Put your back into it, Jala! You'll round 'em all up in a few days!
Eek! A poacher in Fontaine... Does animal trafficking make so much money nowadays?
Not on Paimon's watch! You're coming to the Maison Gardiennage with us!
...Huh. It's you two.
Well, sure. I just came from the Maison, in fact. Need me to show you the way?
Wait, something's not right... You're not scared by the thought of being arrested at all. You must be a regular offender... Or maybe...
I could be standing on the right side of the law, eh?
More accurately, the Maison has hired me as a special environmental protection consultant — an "Unchained Hunter."
Specifically, I'm hunting invasive species of fish that have made their way into Fontaine's waters.
Invasive... species?
Right! Paimon thinks we heard about something like that back in Mondstadt...
Well, let's not dwell on the past. What matters is the here and now.
These invasive species were let loose by some merchants who hold strange beliefs.
Some of the fish are extremely aggressive, others reproduce incredibly fast, and others were raised on special feed. All told, they're a huge problem for all the local aquatic life.
If these fish occupy the habitats of local creatures and mess up the ecosystem, Fontaine's water quality might be affected.
The impact on Fontainians' health might be something we'd only feel in the future. But the flavor of a drink like Fonta could change instantly, and that'll spell untold trouble for the economy.

dialogue.sit: Fonta shall not fall! Not today!
I don't really drink Fonta, but I understand its importance.

dialogue.t: All this understatement makes the problem sound worse! We can't just sit back and do nothing!
Now, we're old hands at catching fish, so why don't we help you out?
Yes! I've been waiting for you to say that!
I've already set up a capture zone into which we can lure all those invasive fish using bait...
So it's time to strut your stuff, Honorary Knight and Helper in White! As for me, I'll support you from the rear!
Is it just Paimon, or does she... understand us really well?

quests.description: In waters south of Lumidouce Harbor, you encounter a rather peculiar individual who calls herself an “Unchained Hunter.” She’s currently in the midst of doing everything she can to contain an impending ecological crisis…
